records.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, production animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the EXACT short slim adult gunman's character model and anatomy reference. Image 2 is the existing sheet, ONLY as painted style reference; REPLACE the Great animation, do not reproduce its inconsistent proportions.
Create exactly FOUR Great-hit forward collapse frames in a precise 2x2 square-cell sheet, ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Transparent background. Each cell is the SAME fixed orthographic camera, same fixed pixels-per-body-unit, same male skeleton and suit. This is one actor moving, NOT four independently resized illustrations.
CRITICAL continuity: keep identical skull/face dimensions, fedora crown and brim dimensions, shoulder breadth, torso from neck to pelvis length, upper-arm/forearm lengths, thigh length, shin length, thigh/shin thickness and shoe length in ALL FOUR poses. Legs may bend/rotate but never shorten, get thinner, thicken or stretch. Never zoom to fill a cell. DO NOT scale the fallen pose to cell width; instead bend knees naturally or use the cell's full width. Head including hat has the same physical size all four frames. Character remains this lean adult, not a bulky alternate actor.
Layout: equal 2x2 cells, plenty of transparent separation and no cross-cell overlap. The same ground baseline 90% down each cell. Pose 1 standing but hunched after hit: one hand clutching chest, gun hand lowering, slight knee bend. Pose 2 descends onto knees, torso tilting SCREEN LEFT, knees/feet trailing SCREEN RIGHT. Pose 3 both knees grounded, one supporting hand on floor SCREEN LEFT, head lowered left, same thigh/shin segments folded naturally. Pose 4 supporting arm gives way and he lies on belly/side, HEAD SCREEN LEFT, feet SCREEN RIGHT, knees bent naturally, same head and limb thickness. Keep his three-quarter facing consistent, no horizontal flip between frames, no body direction reversal.
Match charcoal fine pinstripe suit, burgundy tie, waistcoat watchchain, black fedora, angular mature face, dark pistol and polished black shoes. No blood, muzzle flash, captions, frame borders, panel numbers, shadows on ground or environmental background. True transparent alpha around each complete figure.
